verdict.rationale: Plausible documents scheduled email/Slack reports and traffic spike/drop notifications, which lets a PM subscribe to a dashboard and get alerted when traffic moves abnormally. However, evidence only covers traffic volume spikes/drops, not configurable alerts on arbitrary 'key metrics' (e.g., conversion rate, revenue, custom goals) or threshold customization. Missing for 10: alerting on custom/user-defined metrics beyond traffic, configurable thresholds, and independent hands-on confirmation of alert reliability.
